corePassives.description: When Soi Fon releases the Special Attack - Time's Up or Battlefield Skill - Twin-Strike Execution, she inflicts the enemy with Execution Target for 15 seconds. During this time, whenever the enemy is attacked by any character, an extra Sting equal to 55% of Soi Fon's ATK is triggered. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Tapping Basic Attack after Soi Fon's Perfect Dodge, or her icon after a teammate's Perfect Dodge, triggers Windmill. Cooldown: 14 seconds.

skills.description: Soi Fon releases Hakuda in quick succession, striking 5 times for a total damage equal to 945% of ATK while building her Spiritual Pressure. When releasing the 3rd and 4th hits, Soi Fon gains 1 point of Deathmark. At max Spiritual Pressure, release the 2nd hit of later of Basic Attack. Soi Fon cuts into the enemy with Suzumebachi, dealing total damage equal to 465% of ATK and inflicting Homonka. If the enemy is already marked with Homonka, the attack deals 232.5% of ATK as damage, consumes the mark and deals an extra 275% of ATK as Sting DMG. The first teammate switched in within 8 seconds after releasing the attack will automatically perform their counterattack. The counterattack's damage and Spiritual Pressure Reduction Rate are reduced by 50%. Release Basic Attack after a Perfect Dodge, or by tapping Soi Fon's icon after a teammate's Perfect Dodge to trigger Windmill. Soi Fon teleports in front of the enemy and delivers a series of kicks, dealing damage equal to 157.5% of ATK and gaining 4 points of Deathmark. Tap Basic Atatck after releasing Windmill to release Back Strike. Soi Fon teleports behind the enemy and releases a rapid combo, dealing damage equal to 157.5% of ATK and gaining 4 points of Deathmark. After releasing Back Strike, tap Basic Attack to immediately release the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.
skills.name: Real Assassination

skills.description: While active, Soi Fon's Battlefield Skill increases all teammates' Strike DMG by 40%. It runs on two types of energy — Death Mark and Battlefield Skill Energy — corresponding to her two Battlefield Skills, Combo Strike and Twin-Strike Execution. Soi Fon gains Battlefield Skill Energy by consuming Death Mark, and enters the field with Battlefield Skill Energy already at maximum. Combo Strike: when another teammate lands a hit while Soi Fon's Battlefield Skill Energy isn't at maximum, 1 point of Death Mark is automatically consumed to trigger Combo Strike, dealing 38% of Soi Fon's ATK and granting 1 point of Battlefield Skill Energy. Twin-Strike Execution: Soi Fon teleports to the enemy and strikes with Suzumebachi — if the target isn't marked with Homonka, this deals 755% of her ATK and applies Homonka; if it already is, it instead deals 662% of her ATK and triggers an additional Sting instance for 110% of her ATK, consuming the Homonka mark.
skills.name: Combined Strike
